facts.fact: The broadband strategy names the National KE-CIRT/CC as an operating national response team, which analysed cyber threats for October to December 2017, and calls for strengthening the KE-CERT.
The strategy reports the National KE-CIRT/CC analysed and validated 4,589 cyber threats in October to December 2017 and handled the 539 critical ones that needed immediate response.

The strategy tabulates the 539 critical threats the National KE-CIRT/CC handled in October to December 2017 by attack vector (system misconfiguration 187, malware 140, online impersonation 104); a count by type with no account of action taken.

systems.country_label: National Kenya Computer Incident Response Team Coordination Centre (KE-CIRT/CC)
